🌟 wifi-card | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To create a physical, shareable card with WiFi credentials via a QR code for easy guest access.
✨ Key Features: • Generate QR code for WiFi login details • Printable card format • Supports multiple languages • Local development environment with Docker • Prettier for code formatting and pre-commit hooks
📖 Summary: This JavaScript project, wificard.io, allows users to easily generate and print a physical card containing their WiFi network's login details. It's designed for convenient sharing of WiFi access with guests or household members by presenting the information in a scannable QR code format.
